content.comment_body: Is it possible to start my program running on a PC over an Ethernet connection, instead of only by pressing the button on the [product_name] device? Thanks for your help.
Hello, Yes, this is possible. In [product_name] software you can switch between RUN and STOP for the [product_name]. This option is available on the toolbar. Hope this is useful.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wanted to know if they could remotely start a program on [product_name] hardware through their PC using Ethernet rather than using physical controls on the device. The reply confirms that this functionality is available within the [product_name] software suite, but the placement of the feature may not be obvious to all users, indicating some room for improvement in interface usability for basic remote controls.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to start and control their [product_name] hardware program remotely from their PC, eliminating the need for physical interaction with device buttons.
